channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: The latest: U.S. women’s hockey team, mixed doubles curlers open Olympics with wins
item.description: Curlers and women’s hockey players were first up among the 59 athletes with connections to Minnesota at the 2026 Milan Cortina Games in Italy.

item.title: RandBall: With Rob Dillingham traded, J.J. McCarthy is on the clock
item.description: The two players have been living parallel lives on different Minnesota sports teams.

item.title: Chief public defender outraged by immigration detainments inside Hennepin County courthouse
item.description: But Minnesota’s Fourth Judicial District said in a statement that federal agents can go into the courthouse to detain people.

item.title: Gophers women’s basketball scores rare road upset in beating No. 10 Iowa 91-85
item.description: It’s the Gophers’ first victory at Iowa since 2007, their first victory over a top-10 team since 2018 and their first road victory over a top-10 team since 2003.

item.title: Minneapolis native Larry Fitzgerald Jr. elected to Pro Football Hall of Fame on first ballot
item.description: The one-time Vikings ballboy and former Holy Angels wide receiver is second in NFL history in receptions and receiving yards in a career.

item.title: Feds charge Minneapolis man with threats after early morning raid
item.description: Kyle Wagner is charged with cyberstalking and threats, according to the Justice Department.

item.title: Takeaways: What did the Timberwolves gain as the NBA trade deadline passes?
item.description: For a week, there was speculation the Wolves wanted two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo. In the end, he stayed in Milwaukee.

item.title: In rare move, this northern Minnesota county is working with the feds to make arrests amid ICE surge
item.description: Deputies assisted federal agents in arresting four employees at El Potro Mexican Restaurant in Brainerd.

item.title: Farmington mayor resigns after trading expletives with residents at meeting
item.description: Joshua Hoyt’s resignation is effective immediately. City Council meeting grew heated when the city began enforcing its public comment time limit.

item.title: The latest: State, feds set to announce joint investigation into Alex Pretti shooting, sources say
item.description: The potential agreement comes amid a strained relationship between the FBI and the state’s Bureau of Criminal Apprehension.
